subject: prd/docgate
statement: When discovering projected units for fold state or congruence, docgate shall retain the existing merged-base row-kind inference except that every row whose numbered-section ancestry contains §0 shall be non-addressable.
rationale: the reproduced phantoms are human-only §0 rows, while exact-header enforcement would silently de-govern legitimate rows in frozen bases whose cosmetic labels predate the registered payload schemas; as-of-review evidence (2026-08-20): origin/main carried 95 drifted UB, 26 drifted J, and 5 drifted R rows outside §0
fit_criterion: the real impl-review §0 and nested §0.1 routing tables plus a typed FR-24 supersede are green; an origin/main corpus audit proves zero non-§0 live source-map record disappears from fold state
